{{Top|leg}}
'''Audio surveillance systems''', also known as '''"sound snoopers"''', were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to spy on the citizenry of occupied [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. They could detect transmissions from [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[audio transmitter]]s, but implanted [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] such as the [[At-cyb husher mike]] were able to circumvent the system.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
